clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Laris Geardawdle studies oozes across Azeroth. The gnome researcher gives his academic life to their strange nature and origins, and welcomes adventurers who bring him noxious slime samples.

In the Library of the Hall of Explorers, Laris Geardawdle studies how oozes begin. His dwarven colleagues pore over Titan tablets and ancient stone carvings, but Laris searches the vile, gelatinous horrors of Azeroth for alchemical and biological secrets. He asks roving explorers to gather caustic samples from remote corners of the world. With them, he tests his unusual ideas about how these mindless puddles of malice come to life.
